verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs confirm that `.query` (vector search) and `.get` can combine metadata filtering with `where_document` full-text conditions, so filtered vector search exists. The evidence is only a passing mention inside the full-text-search page, and nothing addresses the story's core concern of recall and latency under filtering. Missing for 10: documented structured metadata operators (equality, range, set membership, boolean logic), evidence that filtered queries preserve recall (e.g. pre-filtering or filter-aware index behavior), latency or benchmark data for filtered search, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
